name: sailboat
description: A cruiser-racer sloop: a round-bilge hull with dark topsides and a teak toe rail, a recessed cockpit with benches and a wheel, a coachroof with windows and a sprayhood, a fin keel with a lead bulb and a spade rudder, a deck-stepped mast with spreaders and standing rigging, lifelines, and cambered mainsail (on a boom that swings about the mast) and jib.
